audience: Watchstanders and shipboard leaders reviewing fictional tasking; this prototype carries no operational authority.
primaryTask: Load or paste synthetic mock OPTASK raw text, extract frequency plans, crypto change-over windows and flight quarters, inspect evidence, resolve uncertainty and save/export a reviewed UTC day.
successOutcome: All named events align on the same 00:00–24:00 UTC axis; each has source evidence, explicit review status and a saved labeled export. Dirty drafts and unresolved alternatives cannot masquerade as approved content.

screens.name: Message and daily schedule
screens.purpose: Primary task workspace: synthetic disclosure, source editor, sample/scenario selector, ship and date filters, consolidated category lanes, event list and source detail.

screens.name: Review and export
screens.purpose: Inspect raw evidence and uncertainties, compare revision values, choose inclusion, acknowledge review and save a local snapshot.

screens.name: About and limitations
screens.purpose: Expose Requirements, Expected deliverables, exact source attribution, invented grammar and operational boundaries.

states.empty: Show a clear first task with Load synthetic sample and labeled raw text; no empty input may imply a confirmed empty day. Initial editor document ID is DRAFT; selectedDay defaults to 2026-11-05 and ship filter is blank (all ships), never the system clock. Sample loading installs its declared day and ship.
states.loading: While POST is pending show Parsing message… in a polite live region, preserve editor text, disable duplicate parse/save and retain the previous saved snapshot visibly labeled.
states.error: Specific line/category diagnostics preserve exact raw input. Editable raw source and previous invalid draft remain available; stale results are labeled and cannot be saved/exported as current. Server unavailable explains Start the local service and retry.
states.success: Display counts, explicit UTC day, named categories and readable 24-hour lanes plus equivalent accessible list. Unreviewed differs from Saved locally. Export requires the current saved snapshot; out-of-day and excluded records stay inspectable.

persistence: localStorage stores raw draft, document batch, selected ship/day, decisions and separately committed saved request/result. Reload restores dirty draft and saved status without approving it. Autosave only drafts; deliberate Save reviewed schedule commits. Loading another sample or discarding dirty work requires explicit Save/reparse or Discard choice; first use and clean replacement load directly. Storage failures are visible and preserve current in-memory text, offering export before leaving. Samples embed exact intake raw text in public/index.html; no browser fixture fetch.
recovery: Correct raw text and reparse; keep previous invalid source in history. Every source edit invalidates pending review/decisions and marks Unsaved changes; saved snapshot remains. Revisions show both times and require one include choice, excluding others. Unresolved diagnostics prevent reviewed save; users correct/reparse. Discard draft restores saved content. Local-only mode blocks remote requests, allows loopback; service stop requires retry, never canned results.
keyboard: Native labeled textarea/input/select/buttons/checks in reading order; strong visible focus; event and field selection use keyboard-operable buttons. Errors announce through live regions and focus summary. On desktop use editor beside schedule/evidence; at 390px stack sections with no page overflow, full-width controls, wrapped source text and readable list alongside a horizontally scrollable labeled timeline. Category text and point/interval shapes supplement color. Use system sans and restrained neutral surfaces; no decorative motion.
